scope: Offline 60 Hz synthetic moving and turning root on one mangrove-island and three savanna positions from Wild Engine; 181 frames each. Reference rig is still evaluated for mesh transforms; candidate reconstructs baked matrices and retains exact CPU foot support. Contact defined solely by <0.03 world units above terrain at both frames, not an authored gait event. Delta errors compare 552 foot-weighted vertices, not absolute sliding quality. No navigation, crowd, GPU, rendering, animation transitions, impacts, other species, irregular dynamic geometry, runtime cost or gameplay.
